sourceRefs.locator: ADC Rapport 2054 (revised December 2011), summary; §4.1.1 house 2 and well 12; C. Nooijen §8.2.1, fig. 8.1 and notes 96–97 for find 330, its metal, legends and estimated striking date.

summary.de: Der Grabungsbericht verzeichnet 1,22 Gramm Gewicht und 39 Prozent Gold. Die geschätzte Prägezeit um 650–660 datiert die Herstellung.
summary.en: The excavation report gives a weight of 1.22 grams and 39 per cent gold. Its proposed date of around 650–660 refers to manufacture.
